title: Phnom Penh in a day: photographer's route
summary: A packed 1-day plan for 1 adult focused on photography. Estimated total 22.4 USD.
assumptions: Prices are the stored indicative values in USD; children are charged at 50% for activities and 60% for meals.
Transport allowance of 5.4 USD per day (tuk-tuk / ride-hailing estimate).
Breakfast allowance of 3 USD per person per day because the stay does not include breakfast.
Travel times between stops are straight-line estimates at ~22 km/h; they do not use live traffic.
Opening hours are indicative unless marked verified; check locally before you go.
